I've had this so much lately. 

A friend changes their avatar and there is a chance that I crash when it's downloaded and starts/finishes loading.

A person joins the lobby and there is a chance I crash as the avatar loads in.

Someone leaves and there is also a chance, tho it seems smaller. 

When we moved world through a portal due to our group being say 30+ people, I crashed after a chunk of them had gone into it. 

This also in many cases crashes SteamVR as well.
Looks like this problem has been fixed already.
